你是外贸工厂的"询盘分析员"。读一条买家询盘，把买家要什么、和工厂能给什么之间的差距找出来，给业务员看。

规则：
- 只根据询盘原文和给你的工厂/产品资料判断，不猜测、不补充外部信息。
- 每一条 requests、signals、conflicts 都必须带 `quote`：从询盘原文里逐字复制的一小段（不超过 20 个词），证明这条判断有出处。找不到原文依据的条目不要写。
- conflicts 只写买家要求和工厂资料确实对不上的地方（认证、付款、交期、运输方式、价格、数量、材料宣称等）。
- 所有说明用简体中文。

只输出 JSON，结构如下：
{
  "buyer": {"country_guess": "...", "language": "en|es|...", "business_type_zh": "...", "sales_channel_zh": "..."},
  "requests": [{"topic_zh": "数量|价格条款|认证|付款|交期|包装|样品|其他", "value": "...", "quote": "..."}],
  "signals": [{"signal_zh": "询盘质量信号，例如：给出具体数量、说明销售渠道、使用公司邮箱", "positive": true, "quote": "..."}],
  "conflicts": [{"topic_zh": "...", "buyer_wants": "...", "factory_can": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "quote": "..."}],
  "summary_zh": "一句话：这个买家是谁、值不值得优先跟进、最大的风险是什么"
}

Hi, we are a kitchenware importer in Texas selling on Amazon. Interested in your 1.7L stainless kettle, 1,200 pcs for first order. Need it UL listed and BPA free, with our logo on the box. Please quote FOB Ningbo by air, we need goods in 20 days. Payment: we usually pay 100% 60 days after delivery. Best, Mark (purchasing@example-kitchen.com)

   "彩盒可印买家 logo：1000 个以上免费，以下每个加收 USD 0.15，需买家提供矢量稿"
  ]
 },
 "product": {
  "id": "KET-17S",
  "name_zh": "1.7L 不锈钢电热水壶",
  "name_en": "1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle",
  "specs": {
   "capacity_l": 1.7,
   "power_w_us": 1500,
   "voltage_us": "120V 60Hz",
   "power_w_mx": 1500,
   "voltage_mx": "127V 60Hz",
   "inner_material": "304 stainless steel",
   "lid_handle_material": "PP plastic",
   "features": [
    "auto shut-off",
    "boil-dry protection",
    "360° swivel base",
    "concealed heating element"
   ]
  },
  "certifications_held": [
   "CB report (IEC 60335-2-15)",
   "CE (LVD/EMC)"
  ],
  "certifications_not_held": [
   "UL",
   "ETL",
   "NOM",
   "FDA registration"
  ],
  "material_tests": {
   "BPA": "未做 BPA 检测报告",
   "LFGB": "未做"
  },
  "moq_units": 500,
  "fob_ningbo_usd": {
   "500-1999": 9.8,
   "2000-4999": 9.2,
   "5000+": 8.7
  },
  "packaging": "color box, 6 units per carton",
  "selling_points_zh": [
   "304 不锈钢内胆",
   "干烧自动断电",
   "360° 旋转底座",
   "隐藏式发热盘，好清洁",
   "5 分钟左右烧开 1.7L（工厂内部测试，非第三方报告）"
  ]
 }
}
